description: Expected bytes are derived by hand from the rule text. AGSC-06-19: 'sitemap.xml MUST list every published route with lastmod from the build instant, ordered by URL'. Three facts are derivable from the rule and only those three are asserted here. (1) Completeness: every published route of AGSC-06-01 appears exactly once. (2) Order: by URL, compared code-point-wise like every other ordering in this specification (AGSC-04-13), so the absolute URLs sort '/' first and '/clusters/coordination/' after '/clusters/'. (3) lastmod: the BUILD INSTANT (AGSC-04-09), one value for every entry, never a per-item date — which is what makes the file byte-reproducible under AGSC-04-02. The XML serialisation itself is NOT asserted, because no rule pins it; the rule's second sentence (schema.org JSON-LD embedded in item and index pages) is asserted only as the closed set of types it names, since the rule does not say which page takes which type.
